title: Classes
explain: A class is a blueprint, and each object made from it keeps its own data. `__init__` sets up a new object and `self` refers to that object. Methods are functions defined inside the class that work on `self`.
exercise: Add a `withdraw` method that refuses to take out more than the balance and prints a message instead.
tip: Forgetting `self` as the first parameter of a method gives a confusing `TypeError` about too many arguments.
